claims.statement: Tom Allen declined Joe Coburn's challenge to fight for $500 or $10,000 (printed as $10,009) until after his contest with Jim Mace in July.
claims.excerpt: Tom Allen declines Joe Coburn’s challenge to fight for $500 or $10,009 until after his (Allen's) contest with Jim Mace in July next.

claims.statement: Tom Allen's contest with Jim Mace was expected to take place in July 1870.
claims.excerpt: until after his (Allen's) contest with Jim Mace in July next.

notes: Dateline 'Saw Frascisco' (San Francisco). The amount is OCR-garbled; hint's $10,000 reading is likely but not printed.
